importNotes: Nutrition values are approximate reference values, not laboratory-tested Egyptian product labels.
Values vary by recipe, brand, cooking method, edible portion, and added oil, salt, or sauce.
Review and validate values with a qualified nutrition professional before using them for athlete prescriptions.
Meal-template nutrition totals are intentionally omitted; calculate them from ingredient foodId and quantityGrams in the backend.
For historical assigned plans, store a snapshot of food name and nutrition values so later library edits do not change old plans.
The goal field uses cutting, bulking, or maintenance. Vegan and high-protein are food tags, not plan goals.
Image fields are null placeholders; add licensed images or your own images before production.
Cooked and raw entries are separate. Select the matching preparation state and avoid mixing raw-food values with cooked weights.
imageNotes: All 50 meal templates have a non-null HTTPS image URL.
The file currently uses 22 distinct hosted photos across 50 meal templates; visually similar meals may share a photo.

Exact Egyptian dish matches are used where found (including koshari, ful, molokhia, hawawshi, kofta, mahshi zucchini, warak enab, freekeh, bamia, feteer, and Egyptian-style fish). Other meals use a close visual match.

Image URLs are externally hosted and may change, block hotlinking, or be removed. For production, obtain commercial-use permission, download approved images, store them in your own object storage/CDN, and retain attribution/license metadata.
Do not assume that a publicly viewable image is free for commercial use. Confirm each source's license before shipping in Trainify.
Items with image = null need a manually added photo: food_051, food_064, food_072, food_074, food_095, food_197, meal_037, meal_039, meal_044, meal_050.
